# TNTP

> TNTP is a leading education nonprofit transforming public K-12 systems through consulting, research, talent development, and community engagement.

TNTP works with school districts nationwide to improve teacher effectiveness, instructional coherence, and student outcomes. The organization combines evidence-based consulting with policy advocacy and professional development to drive systemic education reform.

## Key Topics

- K-12 education
- education consulting
- teacher development
- school improvement
- student success
- instructional coherence
- professional development
- school leadership
- talent development
- education policy
- school districts
- student outcomes
- career pathways
- policy advocacy
- teacher support

## Core Services & Solutions

- [What We Do - TNTP](https://tntp.org/what-we-do): TNTP services: consulting, research, talent development, community engagement
- [Education Consulting | TNTP](https://tntp.org/what-we-do/impact-consulting): TNTP impact consulting: teacher coaching, instructional coherence, student achievement
- [Professional Development For Teachers & Talent Services](https://tntp.org/what-we-do/leadership-development-talent-services): TNTP teacher professional development, leadership training, talent services
- [Research, Policy, and Advocacy - TNTP](https://tntp.org/what-we-do/research-policy-advocacy): TNTP research and policy advocacy for education reform and student opportunity
- [Community Engagement - TNTP](https://tntp.org/what-we-do/community-engagement): TNTP community engagement for educational equity and family partnerships
- [Bring TNTP to Your System - TNTP](https://tntp.org/bring-tntp-to-your-system): TNTP service inquiry form for school districts seeking education solutions
